CASTING CALL — THE BROS SHOW
**SIX ROLES AVAILABLE | SOUTH OR WEST LONDON**

**Unpaid acting opportunities | Independent South London sitcom**

We're expanding the cast of *The Bros Show* and looking for new actors to join our independent comedy series!

*The Bros Show* is a South London teen sitcom combining chaotic comedy, friendship, rivalry, everyday life and mockumentary-style filming. We're looking for people who can bring characters to life through natural acting, personality, banter and strong reactions.

**ROLES AVAILABLE**
1. Lainey — Christmas Special

Guest / Special appearance

Playing age: 17

Description: A confident, blunt and mysterious girl with a long history with Aweys, Abdi and Aiden. She has a habit of appearing unexpectedly, making sarcastic remarks and acting like nothing bothers her.

Character base:
* Childhood friend of the original Bros.
* Childhood partners in crime with Aweys.
* Shares a secret handshake with Aweys.
* Protective of Abdi.
* Enjoys teasing Aiden.
* Has unresolved feelings for Aweys.
* Independent, stubborn and fiercely loyal.

Christmas Special purpose: Her return introduces an unexpected reunion, old memories and a little romantic tension.

**2. POSH BIRD 2**

Playful, mischievous and outspoken. She's always ready to join the group's banter, stir things up and bring chaotic energy to a scene.

**3. POSH BIRD 4**

The wildcard of the group. Flirty, cocky, forceful and unpredictable, she brings tension to the story, particularly through her rivalry with Lainey. This role needs someone who can balance confidence, humour and dramatic presence.

**4. AUNTIE 2**

One half of the auntie duo. We're looking for an actress with expressive reactions, natural delivery, personality and good comedic timing who can bounce off another performer.

**5.** MA-JAX

A cheeky, street-smart teenager from New Harbour who is secretly sort of a prince. Despite his royal connections, he spends most of his time chilling and hanging out with the Bros. His ridiculously grand full name is James Penthony Alexander Jones Max the 8th, but everyone calls him Ma-Jax. He and Aweys operate like partners, often teaming up and coming up with ideas together, while he gets along well with Abdi. However, he has constant beef with Aiden, who regularly throws him out of the house in a running gag reminiscent of Jazz from The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air. He also has an ongoing rivalry with Callum. Most of the others aren't particularly fond of him, although Diva Girl has a soft spot for him. We're looking for an actor with confidence, cheeky personality, natural British delivery, expressive reactions and excellent comedic timing who can bring his chaotic relationships and royal background to life.

**6. PC THOMPSON**

A police constable with a grounded, believable presence. We're looking for clear dialogue, natural acting and strong reactions, with the ability to work well alongside another performer.

1. Posh Bird 3 

 basically herself, playful the quietest most chirpful in the group and doesn't give a damn about the rivaliry simiar to baby spice from the spice girls 

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**
* Natural acting and believable dialogue.
* Good comedic timing and expressive reactions.
* Confidence performing from a short script.
* Reliability and willingness to take direction.
* Availability for agreed rehearsals and filming.

Professional acting experience is welcome but not essential. Applicants should be willing to learn lines and take part in a self-tape audition.

**LOCATION REQUIREMENT**

Applicants must be based in **South or West London** and able to travel to agreed filming and rehearsal locations.

**SELF-TAPE DEADLINES**

Shortlisted applicants will normally have **3 days to submit their self-tape**, with a maximum of **5 days** where that is the agreed deadline.

If you need additional time, contact the casting team before your deadline. Reasonable extensions may be agreed.

Please take deadlines seriously. If an applicant repeatedly misses an agreed deadline without communicating, their audition may be withdrawn and another candidate considered.

**PRODUCTION TERMS**
* This is an unpaid independent production.
* Travel, food and other expenses are not guaranteed.
* Filming dates, rehearsal arrangements and locations will be discussed with shortlisted applicants before any commitment.
* Applicants under 18 must involve a parent or guardian in the casting and production arrangements.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Please send:
1. Your preferred name.
2. Your age.
3. Your general location (South or West London).
4. Recent photos.
5. Acting experience or a showreel, if available.
6. Your availability for rehearsals and filming.
7. Which role or roles you would like to audition for.

Please don't send your full home address or other sensitive personal information.

Shortlisted applicants will receive further audition instructions and their self-tape scene.

**ABOUT THE PROJECT**

We're building a cast for an original independent series, and this is an opportunity to be part of a developing creative project. Please apply only if you're comfortable with the unpaid terms and can communicate reliably with the production team.

**THE BROS SHOW — Seven ROLES. ONE CHAOTIC UNIVERSE.**

If you're interested, get in touch and tell us which character you'd like to play!

NIEZALEŻNY FILM KRÓTKOMETRAŻOWY „KOPIA” – POSZUKUJEMY WSPÓŁPRACOWNIKÓW | WARSZAWA / MAZOWIECKIE

Przygotowujemy niezależny film krótkometrażowy z pogranicza thrillera psychologicznego i science fiction. Poszukujemy osób zainteresowanych współtworzeniem kameralnej produkcji filmowej, realizowanej z naciskiem na stronę wizualną, atmosferę i precyzyjną pracę z aktorem.

O PROJEKCIE

„Kopia” opowiada o małżeństwie, którego życie zostaje zakłócone przez pojawienie się tajemniczej kobiety wyglądającej identycznie jak żona głównego bohatera. Film porusza temat tożsamości, relacji międzyludzkich i granic ludzkiej natury.

PLAN PRODUKCJI

* 5 dni zdjęciowych
* Planowany termin: druga połowa grudnia 2026
* Główna lokacja: dom z ogrodem w okolicach Warszawy
* Kilka dodatkowych lokacji
* Kameralna ekipa i praca z jedną kamerą
* Film planowany do zgłoszeń na festiwale filmowe w Polsce i za granicą

Termin i harmonogram wymagają jeszcze ostatecznego potwierdzenia.

POSZUKUJEMY PRZEDE WSZYSTKIM:

* Producenta / kierownika produkcji – do wsparcia organizacji, logistyki, budżetu, pozyskania i uzgodnienia lokacji oraz koordynacji przygotowań i zdjęć.
* Gaffera / szefa oświetlenia – do współpracy przy przygotowaniu i realizacji koncepcji oświetleniowej.
* 1st AC / focus pullera – do obsługi kamery i pracy z ostrością 
* Script supervisora – do nadzorowania ciągłości scen podczas zdjęć.

DODATKOWE WSPÓŁPRACE

Jesteśmy również otwarci na kontakt z fryzjerami, charakteryzatorami, makijażystami, stylistami, kostiumografami, projektantami i markami odzieżowymi zainteresowanymi współpracą przy filmie.

Zapraszamy także początkujących twórców i studentów, którzy chcieliby zdobyć praktyczne doświadczenie na planie i rozwinąć swoje portfolio. Jeśli masz umiejętności lub zasoby, które mogłyby wzbogacić projekt, napisz do nas.

WARUNKI WSPÓŁPRACY

Jest to niezależna produkcja non-profit, obecnie finansowana ze środków własnych zespołu. Na tym etapie nie dysponujemy budżetem na wynagrodzenia. Współpraca ma charakter nieodpłatny, a ewentualny zwrot wcześniej uzgodnionych kosztów będzie ustalany indywidualnie przed rozpoczęciem współpracy.

KONTAKT

Osoby zainteresowane prosimy o wiadomość prywatną lub kontakt mailowy:

dop.marinich@gmail.com

Prosimy o kilka słów o sobie, informację o doświadczeniu oraz link do portfolio lub wcześniejszych realizacji.

Director of Photography: Vasilii Marinich
Showreel: https://vimeo.com/marinichfilms/showreel

🎉📺 SOBOTA W PRUSZKOWIE! ZAPRASZAMY NA WIELKIE TELEWIZYJNE EMOCJE! 📺🎉

Macie ochotę zobaczyć, jak wygląda telewizja od kulis? A może po prostu spędzić sobotę w ciekawy sposób, poczuć atmosferę telewizyjnego show i jeszcze zarobić? 😁

Już w sobotę, 7 listopada, zapraszamy Was na nagranie NOWEGO TELETURNIEJU, które odbędzie się w ARENIE PRUSZKÓW!

Szukamy osób od 18. roku życia, które chcą zasiąść na widowni, stworzyć fantastyczną atmosferę i wspólnie z nami przeżyć telewizyjną przygodę! 🎬

CO NA WAS CZEKA?

💰 100 zł wynagrodzenia – płatne gotówką po nagraniu!
🍽️ Obiad dla każdej osoby w przerwie nagrania!
🎥 Możliwość zobaczenia telewizji od kuchni!
🙌 Świetna atmosfera i niezapomniane emocje!

SZCZEGÓŁY:

📅 Sobota, 7.11
📍 Arena Pruszków, ul. Andrzeja 1
🕚 Zbiórka o godz. 11:00
🕖 Planowany koniec około godz. 19:00
🚆 Najwygodniejszy dojazd kolejką WKD.

UBIÓR: Codzienny, schludny. Bez dresów i ubrań z  logotypami.

📲 JAK SIĘ ZAPISAĆ?

Wystarczy wysłać SMS na numer:

512 383 313

W treści wpisz: PRUSZKÓW, imię, nazwisko, wiek

Każda zapisana osoba otrzyma od nas SMS z potwierdzeniem udziału.

Nie zwlekajcie! Zabierzcie ze sobą dobry humor i znajomych dołączcie do naszej telewizyjnej ekipy! ❤️

Czekamy na Was!

RODO: Administratorem danych osobowych jest Publico TV. Dane osobowe będą przetwarzane w celu organizacji zapisów, kontaktu z uczestnikami oraz realizacji udziału w nagraniu. Podanie danych jest dobrowolne, ale niezbędne do dokonania zapisu. Przysługuje Państwu prawo dostępu do danych, ich sprostowania, usunięcia i ograniczenia przetwarzania oraz wniesienia skargi do Prezesa UODO.

Organic Social commercial for Lumoscope

**CASTING:** Two lead actors, one male (Dev) and one female (Maya), mid-20s to early 30s. We’re looking for people who could play established young professionals with great skin who clearly take care of themselves. Ethnically diverse actors are encouraged to submit.

**LOCATION:** Oakland Hills, Oakland, California, USA or San Francisco, CA

**COMPENSATION:** PAYING: $350-$500 for the day, per actor (rate based on experience)

**CONTACT: **jun@prologmedia.org, please put “Lumoscope Casting” in the subject line and include your headshot, a link to your reel or resume if you have one, and your location

**TIME(s):**
* Submission deadline: No submission deadline
* Auditions/callbacks: Self tape video 
* Production: Sunday, November 1, 2026, one day, from late morning to mid evening

**PROJECT DETAILS:** Two people live out parallel lives getting ready for a first date together, using Lumoscope, an iPhone attachment that scans your skin and gives you information for better skincare, to look their best. Over a few weeks, each follows their own skincare routine in the lead-up to meeting.

**Status:** Non-union. Organic social use only.

**About us:** We’re a newly formed advertising agency for tech startups, and our website is still in the works. Here’s my LinkedIn, plus our previous work with Lumeria, the company we’re casting for:
* Jun Hee Lee: [[https://www.linkedin.com/in/jun-hee-lee-b0454897/](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jun-hee-lee-b0454897/)](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jun-hee-lee-b0454897/)
* Previous Lumeria work: [[https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7493328349721956353/](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7493328349721956353/)](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7493328349721956353/)

**COMPENSATION:** PAYING: $350-$500 for the day, per actor (rate based on experience)

Over a few weeks, each follows their own skincare routine in the lead-up to meeting.

**Status:** Non-union. Organic social use only.

🎬🔥 ATTENTION, LOS ANGELES FILMMAKERS & ENTERTAINMENT INDUSTRY! 🔥🎬

Walk the red carpet, take photos with fellow filmmakers and celebrity guests, and enjoy an exciting night celebrating independent cinema!

See our cast and crew live, including Tommy Wiseau, Vernon Davis, Malcolm Goodwin, David Anders, Olivia Grace Applegate, and other incredible talent, alongside special-guest celebrities, influencers, and entertainment media!

🚀 An incredible networking opportunity! We’re bringing together buyers, including executives from major streaming platforms and top film distribution companies, creating an exciting opportunity to connect with industry professionals, meet potential collaborators, and build valuable relationships.

🎥 HERE’S WHAT TO EXPECT:

🔴 Red carpet arrivals and photo opportunities

🍿 World premiere double feature: DEAD DAWN & SILT

🎤 Live cast and crew Q&A

🥂 Cocktail reception

🎧 After-party with a DJ

🤝 Networking with filmmakers, actors, producers, celebrities, influencers, and entertainment industry professionals!

👇 CHECK OUT THE LINK BELOW! The trailers are embedded, along with more information about both films and tickets.

🎟️ Tickets are limited, so grab yours while they’re still available!

I also want to thank everyone in this group for the support, encouragement, and help along the way in getting these films completed. Independent filmmaking takes a village, and I would love to celebrate with you all in LA!

Come watch two movies, walk the red carpet, take some great photos, enjoy cocktails and a DJ after-party, and make some new industry connections. Let’s make it a night to remember! 🎬🔥🥂

CASTING NOTICE

Hit The Buffers (Working title)

Genres: Mystery, Crime, Neo-noir, Drama.

A short film designed to procure funding for a feature film.

Main Characters:

Jake - Lead

Age: 35-45

Gender: Male

Description: Ex-SAS, now a mortician. 

Positive, alpha and upbeat with a dark sense of humour. 

Highly tuned into spotting and eliminating potential threats.

Must be physically strong and able to lift moderate to heavy objects.

Licences: Driver's licence essential. 

Boat licence and PADI/diver's licence helpful.

Special Skills: stunts, musical instruments, dance and languages are an advantage. Experience with firearms or willing to train at a later date.

Alice - Lead

Age: 15-25

Gender: Female

Description: A ruthless survivor and Jake's sidekick as a mortician. Brutally honest and logical with a dark sense of humour. 

Must be physically strong and able to lift moderate to heavy objects.

Licences: L Plates or Driver's licence essential. 

Boat licence and PADI/diver's licence helpful.

Must be a competent swimmer.

Special Skills: stunts, musical instruments, dance and languages are an advantage. Experience with firearms or willing to train at a later date.

Rates of Pay: $500AUD minimum per day - negotiable depending on experience.

Expenses: Travel, Accommodation and Subsistence provided.

Shooting Location: Hervey Bay, Queensland Australia.

Shooting Dates: Initially a two-day shoot, December 2026. Dates TBC. 

CONTACT

Nigel Squires - Director

Hervey Bay Film Festival

nigel@hbff.com.au

https://hbff.com.au/

Link to upload resumes:

https://hbff.com.au/hervey-bay-film-festival-contact/

https://www.instagram.com/herveybayfilmfestival/

# 🎭 SHOGUNS THEATER – CASTING 2026 🎭

 Schauspielerin gesucht für die Hauptrolle „Eva"

 Für das moderne Bewusstseins-Theaterstück

DIE SCHÖPFUNG

Kein religiöses Theater.
Keine klassische Bibelinszenierung.

„Die Schöpfung“** ist ein modernes, philosophisches Bühnenwerk über Bewusstsein, Ursprung, Menschsein, Freiheit, Licht & Schatten. Ein emotionales, poetisches und kraftvolles Theatererlebnis zwischen Symbolik, Schauspiel, Körperausdruck und innerer Wahrheit.

Gesucht wird eine ausdrucksstarke Schauspielerin im Alter von 20 bis 47 Jahren für die Rolle **Eva** – sowie für mehrere symbolische Nebenrollen innerhalb des Stücks.

✨ Was ich suche

Eine Schauspielerin mit:

* starker Bühnenpräsenz
* emotionaler Tiefe
* Mut zur Ausdruckskraft
* Offenheit für modernes, intensives Theater
* Interesse an bewusstseinsorientierter Kunst

Die Rolle „Eva“ verkörpert nicht Religion – sondern den Ursprung des Menschen, Weiblichkeit, Erkenntnis, Freiheit und Bewusstsein.

 🎭 Wichtiger Hinweis zur Rolle

Für einzelne Szenen der Inszenierung sollte die Darstellerin keine Hemmungen gegenüber künstlerischer Nacktheit haben.
Die Darstellung erfolgt ästhetisch, symbolisch und theaterkünstlerisch – niemals vulgär oder voyeuristisch.
Körperlichkeit dient ausschließlich der künstlerischen Aussage des Stücks.

 📍 CASTING – November 

13.11/ 14.11/ 21.11/22.11

Gesucht werden sowohl erfahrene Schauspielerinnen als auch starke neue Persönlichkeiten mit natürlicher Ausstrahlung.

Gage pro Auftritt Fr. 500 ( 3 Auftritte in Planung)
Gage Netto Proben Fr. 1700

Es handelt sich um ein Pilotprojekt wenn eine Tournee daraus erfolgt wären bis 30 Auftritte vorgesehen

Aufführungen sind Rickenbach SO Schweiz
 📩 Bewerbung an:

[wehrlipeter4@gmail.com

oder über die Homepage:

https://der-mensch-neue-erkentnisse.jimdosite.com/

 SHOGUNS THEATER
 „Theater darf nicht nur unterhalten.
Es darf erinnern, erschüttern und Bewusstsein erschaffen.“

Do kolejnego listopadowego odcinka 2. sezonu fabularnego serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję aktorów do następujących ról:

1.Bocian (35) – postawny, łysy, tatuaże, agresywny, porywczy, typ gangusa  - prawo jazdy
Data: 11 i 12. listopada
Stawka: 1600 zł netto za całość

2.Artur (27) – pracownik lakierni samochodowej. Dobrze zbudowany, postawny, krótkie włosy. Konkretny, chętnie rozmawia z policją.
Data: 11 listopada
Stawka: 600 zł netto

3.Stróż (60) – stróż pracujący na złomowisku. Ciekawski, interesuje się wszystkim dookoła. 
Data: 12 listopada
Stawka: 400 zł netto

4.Gangster 3 (41) – Gangster zatrzymany na złomowisku. Wysoki, chudy, tatuaże. Na początku nie chce pracować z policją, ale dociśnięty sypie wszystkich współpracowników.
Data: 12 i 13 listopada
Stawka: 1600 zł netto za całość

Chętnych aktorów zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania
9. Data lub odcinek grania w pierwszym sezonie Gliniarzy Śląsk

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

🎬 **CASTING – NAUCZYCIELKA (ROLA MÓWIONA)**

📅 **DATA: 5.11 (CZWARTEK) – GODZINY POPOŁUDNIOWE**

📍 **LOKALIZACJA: WARSZAWA, GROCHÓW**

💰 **STAWKA: 250 ZŁ**

Do odcinka serialu internetowego poszukujemy aktorki do roli nauczycielki geografii.

**Rola obejmuje jedną krótką scenę w sali lekcyjnej.**

**Wymagania:**
* Wiek ekranowy: 35–55 lat
* Mile widziane doświadczenie aktorskie
* dostępność na terenie Warszawy (nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu)

**Zgłoszenia prosimy przesyłać w wiadomości prywatnej, dołączając:**
* Imię i nazwisko
* Wiek
* Aktualne zdjęcia
* **Demo aktorskie lub próbki dotychczasowych występów.** W przypadku braku takich materiałów prosimy o nagranie krótkiej, autorskiej scenki w roli nauczycielki prowadzącej lekcję (np. próbującej zapanować nad niesforną klasą).

❗ **Prosimy o przesyłanie materiałów aktorskich od razu ze zgłoszeniem. Zgłoszenia bez nagrań nie będą rozpatrywane.**

Zastrzegamy sobie kontakt wyłącznie z wybranymi kandydatkami.

🎬 **CASTING CALL: CLACK** 🎬 *Clack* is an intimate, darkly playful short centered around two young women caught in an increasingly provocative guessing game. What begins as teasing slowly shifts into something more seductive and dangerous, as one character begins to draw the other further out of her comfort zone.

We are casting for **TWO FEMALE LEADS**:

👉 **JEAN**
* **Playing age:** Mid-20s
* **Description:** Magnetic, confident, and mischievous. She has an almost "devil on your shoulder" energy – playful, provocative, and always slightly in control.

👉 **[TBC / SECOND LEAD]**
* **Playing age:** Mid-20s
* **Description:** Warm, curious, and initially more reserved. There is an innocence to her, but throughout the scene we begin to see her drawn into the other woman's world.

🎥 **STYLE & NOTE:** The film will be shot in a very intimate visual style, using close-ups and extreme close-ups to build chemistry, tension, and a playful sense of danger between the characters. **(NO PHYSICAL TOUCH)**

📅 **DETAILS:**
* **Shoot Date:** Tuesday, 24 November 2026
* **Shoot Location:** Edinburgh - exact location TBC
* **Compensation:** Unpaid student film – bus fare, lunch, and snacks will be provided

⏳ **APPLY BY FRIDAY, 6 NOVEMBER (12:00)!** To apply, please send a headshot, acting CV/showreel (if available), and a short introduction to: 📧 **40853404@live.napier.ac.uk**

#CastingCall #FilmEdinburgh #EdinburghNapier #ScreenAcademyScotland #ShortFilm #ActorsWanted #FemaleLeads

🎬🎬🎬 MEGA ULTRA PILNE! CASTING! 🎬🎬🎬

AKTORKI, AKTORZY,  EPIZODYSTKI I EPIZODYŚCI 

– ROLKI / TIKTOK / IG

Szanowni Państwo!

Na czwartek, 12 listopada 

poszukujemy aktorek, aktorów,  epizodystek i epizodystów 

do krótkiej formy komercyjnej realizowanej 
na potrzeby kanałów TikTok i Instagram (IG).

🎥 KOGO SZUKAMY?

✅ Kobiet i mężczyzn w wieku 25–50 lat 

✅ Osób polskojęzycznych 

✅ Osób posiadających doświadczenie w pracy przed kamerą

Poszukujemy osób do wielu różnych ról, 
które wcielą się w postaci pracowników 
i klientów marketu.

💰 WYNAGRODZENIE: 500–1000 zł netto

Stawka uzależniona jest od przypisanej postaci i zakresu roli. 
Po zakwalifikowaniu zgłoszonych osób 
do konkretnych postaci skontaktujemy się 
z wybranymi osobami i poinformujemy je 
o proponowanej stawce.

Der Kino Mittwoch auf radioYpsilon, dein Lieblingssender 

MOVIETIME KW 45/2026

KONKURRENZ FÜR EBERHOFER, JAPANISCHE URZEITACTION UND DIE KINOCHARTS OKTOBER

Die Buchreihe von Jörg Maurer über den bayrischen Kommissar Jennerwein feiert ihr Leinwanddebüt. 

Seit mehr als 70 Jahren, erstmals 1954, ist das Urzeitreptil Godzilla im Kino aktiv. Nach mehreren US Versionen in den letzten Jahren gibt es nun eine weitere Fortsetzung aus Japan mit Godzilla Minus Zero. 

Neben weiteren Filmtipps, den österreichischen Kinocharts sowie vielen Moviesongs präsentiert Sarah Fuchs noch interessante Interviews mit Sebastian Brameshuber (LONDON) und Hannah Wahl (Mabacher Award)

Mittwoch 4.11.2026 von 18 bis 19h auf radioYpsilon 94.5 oder via Stream (http://mp3.radioypsilon.at:8000/)

Actors are taught to work for the camera. But what changes when the camera is actually there?

In a self-tape, an audition or on set, the challenge is the same, making the performance feel real to the person watching.

At our FREE live Acting Masterclass, you’ll see actors demonstrate The Inspire Technique’s scripted and improv approaches in before and after performances. 

You’ll see what changes in the work, then get Michael Keogh’s breakdown of how the approach applies across performances.

Attend live and receive The Professional Actor’s Guide to Understanding the Film Lens, our FREE guide valued at $97.

Michael has had a 25-year acting career and is an award-winning director. His screen credits include Peaky Blinders, Casualty and Marvel’s Secret Invasion, to name a few.

Sunday 8 November · 6PM GMT / 1PM ET

RSVP AT THE FOLLOWING LINK:
https://bit.ly/4pCzU5V

items.text:
Hello my name is Amy, my passion is acting and I am also an aerialist, I love singing. It's been my forever dream to be an actress/singer. I'm struggling to get into college due to my age and lack of grades due to being in hospital. 

I have advocated and been on television speaking out and done some radio work, nothing big but used my voice to speak out against abuse within the mental health system as a neurodiverse person. I am in my 20s.

But I really want to act and get some experience as soon as possible, my dreams are the reason I am here and survived systematic abuse. But now I am finally free. I am struggling to get into the industry, but I feel like I have alot to give and have already used my experiences and voice. My story was taken to parliament and I have done work with Journalists and BBC producers. Helped with restraint reduction network projects. And more...

But I feel I could use this life experience and my knowledge of having to learn my body and expression to survive and assess my safety.
Anyway coming away from that, I don't want being trapped in the system for so long and my now age to get in the way of my dreams, that I have been long awaiting to fullfillment, I have potential I just need a path. 

If you can help please do message or comment. I am Blackpool Based. Thank you so very much!

topComments.text: Sent you an Urgent Casting Call link on behalf of another filmmaker in your Inbox to help ya, maybe get you started.

😂 Listopad w Pomorskim Teatrze Nobilis? Tylko z dużą dawką śmiechu!
🎭 6–7 listopada „Plagiat”, 27–28 listopada „Dwanaście scen z życia Matki” — wybierzcie swój wieczór i wpadajcie do teatru!

sharedPost.text:
😂 W LISTOPADZIE POMORSKI TEATR NOBILIS ROZŚMIESZA DO ŁEZ!

Dwa tytuły. Cztery wieczory. I jeden plan: bawić się naprawdę dobrze. 🎭

🔥 6–7 listopada – „PLAGIAT”
Kryminalna intryga, absurd, zaskoczenia i humor, który nie pozwala siedzieć spokojnie na widowni .

❤️ 27–28 listopada – „DWANAŚCIE SCEN Z ŻYCIA MATKI”
Znana i lubiana komedia, w której śmiejemy się z matek, dzieci, rodzin… i bardzo często z samych siebie. 😄

Jeśli listopad kojarzy Wam się z szarością, mamy lepszy pomysł:
wyjście do teatru, dużo śmiechu i wieczór, po którym wraca się do domu w zdecydowanie lepszym humorze.

🎟️ Bilety są już w sprzedaży. w MDK Rumia albo pod adresem: 
https://www.kupbilecik.pl/pl/place/6702/scena-mdk-rumia-galeria-rumia

Wybierzcie spektakl, zabierzcie kogoś, z kim lubicie się śmiać, i widzimy się na widowni!

👉 Nie odkładajcie zakupu na później. Wybierzcie swój termin już dziś.

Pomorski Teatr Nobilis – w listopadzie rozśmieszamy do łez! 😂🎭

**NOW CASTING: TikTok LIVE Host | Natural Hair & Curl Care**
Culver City, Los Angeles
Favored is looking for a host to join our TikTok LIVE shopping streams for a well-known hair care brand!
**What you’ll do:**
* Showcase natural curls and demonstrate curl-enhancing hair products
* Share hair care tips, curl routines, and product recommendations
* Engage with viewers and bring products to life in real time

**Who we’re looking for:**
* Individuals with Type 3 or Type 4 hair and natural curls
* Confident, engaging, and comfortable on camera
* Knowledgeable about natural hair care, curl routines, and styling products

**Role details:** Paid — rate based on experience
2–4 hour in-studio streams
1–2 shows per week
Potential for recurring opportunities

**Interested?** Email **livehostcasting@favored.live** and we’ll send you the submission form with next steps!

Hey everyone! 👋
We’re currently casting for our upcoming short film Doe-Eyes, and we’re looking for approximately 20 supporting artists (party extras) to help bring our house-party scenes to life!

About the Project:

Doe-Eyes is a psychological drama exploring male accountability, complicity and the silence surrounding sexual violence. Set against the backdrop of a house party, the film follows two young men whose friendship is challenged when a disturbing truth begins to emerge.

Who We’re Looking For:

We’re looking for actors, models and aspiring performers of all genders, aged approximately 18–22, to portray guests at a lively house party.

Shooting Details:

📅 Date: Tuesday, 17 November 2026

🕓 Time: 4:00 PM – 7:00 PM (3 hours)

📍 Location: Kew Curve, Brentford, TW8 0EX

What We Offer:

This is an unpaid student production, offering the opportunity to gain practical on-set experience, work alongside a dedicated filmmaking team and contribute to a short film intended for festival submissions.

Food and refreshments will be provided, alongside screen credit.

Sensitive Content:

Although the wider film explores themes of sexual assault, consent and accountability, supporting artists will only be involved in the house-party sequences. No participation in intimate or explicit scenes will be required. Appropriate safeguarding measures will be in place throughout production.

How to Apply:

If you’re interested, please email alfieshadbolt45@gmail.com with:

* A short introduction about yourself

* Your age

* A recent photograph and/or acting/modelling portfolio

* Alternatively, links to your social media profiles if you don’t have a portfolio

Love films? Want to meet new people? This event is for you!

Join Film Society Denmark for an evening of film trivia, charades and a lot of laughs at Urban House Copenhagen!

Come with friends or come solo. Everyone gets a chance to be part of a team, so it’s one of the easiest ways to meet fellow film lovers in Copenhagen and make friends!

Film trivia: classics, blockbusters, world cinema

Kino Klub is like a book club, but for movies and TV shows. 

Open to everyone! Free entry, registration required. 

Snacks and beverages will be available to buy at the café.

CASTING CALL – WEDNESDAY THE BLOOD BALL🖤
Studentischer Kurzfilm der Lazi Filmakademie Esslingen

Wir suchen unsere Hauptdarstellerin!

Für unseren studentischen Kurzfilm *Wednesday – The Blood Ball* suchen wir eine Darstellerin für die Hauptrolle Wednesday.

Der etwa 3–4-minütige Film zeigt eine düstere Gothic-Ballsaal-Szene mit einer markanten Tanzsequenz und einem anschließenden Blutregen-Effekt. Unsere eigene Inszenierung orientiert sich visuell an der bekannten Tanzszene aus der Netflix-Serie Wednesday.

DIE ROLLE

Wednesday ist die zentrale Figur des Films. Besonders wichtig sind ihre charakteristischen Tanzbewegungen, Posen und ihre ausdrucksstarke Körpersprache.

Was du mitbringen solltest:

- Gutes Körper- und Rhythmusgefühl sowie flüssige, kontrollierte Bewegungen.

- Ausdrucksstarke Mimik und Körpersprache.

- Die Fähigkeit, die Tanzbewegungen der Referenz möglichst präzise einzustudieren.

- Bereitschaft zu Kostüm, Make-up und Haarstyling sowie zur Teilnahme an der Blutregen-Szene.

Du musst keine professionelle Tänzerin sein. Die Umsetzung der Choreografie ist uns wichtiger als eine perfekte optische Ähnlichkeit.

TANZREFERENZ

Als Orientierung dient die Tanzszene aus der Serie:

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NakTu_VZxJ0](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NakTu_VZxJ0)

Bitte studiere die Bewegungen und Posen für dein Bewerbungsvideo ein.

DAS BRAUCHEN WIR VON DIR

1. Porträtfoto und Ganzkörperfoto

Zwei aktuelle Fotos, auf denen dein Gesicht beziehungsweise deine gesamte Person gut erkennbar sind.

2. Vorstellungsvideo (max 60 Sekunden)

Stelle dich kurz vor und erzähle uns:

- Wie heißt du und woher kommst du?

- Warum interessiert dich die Rolle Wednesday?

- Was reizt dich an der Tanz-Challenge?

3. Tanzvideo – besonders wichtig

Zeige uns, wie du die Tanzbewegungen und Posen anhand der Referenz nachstellen kannst.

- Möglichst eine durchgehende, ungeschnittene Aufnahme.

- Kopf und Füße müssen während des Tanzes sichtbar sein.

- Normale Geschwindigkeit, keine Filter oder KI-Manipulationen.

- Einfache Smartphone-Aufnahmen reichen vollkommen aus.

PROJEKT UND RAHMENBEDINGUNGEN

- Drehregion:  Esslingen / Stuttgart

- Geplanter Dreh:  Nacht vom 9. auf den 10. Januar 2027 (noch nicht endgültig bestätigt)

- Produktion:  Studentischer No-Budget-Kurzfilm

- Gage:  Leider nicht möglich

- Verpflegung:  Essen und Getränke am Set

- Anreise / Unterkunft:   Kann nach Absprache geprüft werden, ist jedoch nicht garantiert.

**Wichtiger Hinweis:** Während der Blutregen-Szene können Gesicht, Haare und Kleidung mit roter Effektflüssigkeit nass und sichtbar verschmutzt werden. Flecken lassen sich möglicherweise nicht vollständig entfernen.

BEWERBUNG

Bitte sende deine Bewerbung mit dem Betreff **WEDNESDAY CASTING – Vorname Nachname** an:

**[wednesday.bloodball.casting@gmail.com](mailto\:wednesday.bloodball.casting@gmail.com)**

Kleinere Dateien kannst du direkt anhängen. Größere Videos bitte über einen Freigabelink (z. B. Google Drive) bereitstellen. Bitte gib außerdem deinen Wohnort und deine Verfügbarkeit für den geplanten Dreh an.

- **Bewerbungsschluss:** Sonntag, 22. November 2026

- **Rückmeldung zur Besetzung:** spätestens Sonntag, 29. November 2026

Bei Interesse können wir anschließend ein kurzes Online-Gespräch vereinbaren.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

*Deine Bewerbungsunterlagen werden ausschließlich für das Casting verwendet und nur den daran beteiligten Personen zugänglich gemacht. Informationen zur Speicherung und Löschung erhältst du über die Kontaktadresse.*

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NakTu_VZxJ0](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NakTu_VZxJ0)

Bitte studiere die Bewegungen und Posen für dein Bewerbungsvideo ein.

DAS BRAUCHEN WIR VON DIR

1. Porträtfoto und Ganzkörperfoto

Zwei aktuelle Fotos, auf denen dein Gesicht beziehungsweise deine gesamte Person gut erkennbar sind.

2. Vorstellungsvideo (max 60 Sekunden)

Stelle dich kurz vor und erzähle uns:

- Wie heißt du und woher kommst du?

- Warum interessiert dich die Rolle Wednesday?

- Was reizt dich an der Tanz-Challenge?

3. Tanzvideo – besonders wichtig

Zeige uns, wie du die Tanzbewegungen und Posen anhand der Referenz nachstellen kannst.

- Möglichst eine durchgehende, ungeschnittene Aufnahme.

- Kopf und Füße müssen während des Tanzes sichtbar sein.

- Normale Geschwindigkeit, keine Filter oder KI-Manipulationen.

- Einfache Smartphone-Aufnahmen reichen vollkommen aus.

PROJEKT UND RAHMENBEDINGUNGEN

- Drehregion:  Esslingen / Stuttgart

- Geplanter Dreh:  Nacht vom 9. auf den 10. Januar 2027 (noch nicht endgültig bestätigt)

- Produktion:  Studentischer No-Budget-Kurzfilm

- Gage:  Leider nicht möglich

- Verpflegung:  Essen und Getränke am Set

- Anreise / Unterkunft:   Kann nach Absprache geprüft werden, ist jedoch nicht garantiert.

**Wichtiger Hinweis:** Während der Blutregen-Szene können Gesicht, Haare und Kleidung mit roter Effektflüssigkeit nass und sichtbar verschmutzt werden. Flecken lassen sich möglicherweise nicht vollständig entfernen.

BEWERBUNG

Bitte sende deine Bewerbung mit dem Betreff **WEDNESDAY CASTING – Vorname Nachname** an:

**[wednesday.bloodball.casting@gmail.com](mailto\:wednesday.bloodball.casting@gmail.com)**

Kleinere Dateien kannst du direkt anhängen. Größere Videos bitte über einen Freigabelink (z. B. Google Drive) bereitstellen. Bitte gib außerdem deinen Wohnort und deine Verfügbarkeit für den geplanten Dreh an.

- **Bewerbungsschluss:** Sonntag, 22. November 2026

- **Rückmeldung zur Besetzung:** spätestens Sonntag, 29. November 2026

Bei Interesse können wir anschließend ein kurzes Online-Gespräch vereinbaren.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

*Deine Bewerbungsunterlagen werden ausschließlich für das Casting verwendet und nur den daran beteiligten Personen zugänglich gemacht. Informationen zur Speicherung und Löschung erhältst du über die Kontaktadresse.*

COACHING SERVICES!
Hi all, my name is Aaron Latta-Morissette and I’m a bi-coastal, SAG actor and screenwriter. Over the last 15 years, I’ve had the pleasure of  working on projects for HBO, Netflix, Apple TV, studio movies, indie films, music videos, commercials, and Off-Broadway/Regional theatre!

I know that maintaining momentum and control in your career can often feel like an up-hill battle, and starting from square one can be SO overwhelming! For that reason, I’m opening up my client list to anyone who may be looking to jump-start their acting journey. If you’re just starting out, or have been hustling for a while, I’m here to help:

- Self Submissions! How to stand out in your online profiles (Actors Access, Backstage, Casting Networks, etc.) and bring in work on your own… For nearly a decade I had no representation and still managed to get booked on major streaming services, indie films, theatre and commercials. Reps get 10% because we should be doing 90% of the work!

- Auditions! Consider me your go-to resource for line-running, audition reading, and script analysis. Like working out in the gym, even if you have great technique and strength, you will ALWAYS see more results from having a partner there to push you further.

- Career Building! Together, we’ll compile an up to date list of all your growing connections in the industry and stay on top of the best ways to interact, invite, and initiate dialogue when the right project comes up. 

If you’re interested, DM me! I’d love to hop on a free 30min Zoom to get an idea of your goals and see if I’d be the right fit for your career.

CASTING DO SERIALU #MŁODEGLINY🎬 #bmx 
TYLKO OSOBY Z DOŚWIADCZENIEM AKTORSKIM

Poszukujemy młodego aktora (wiek 16-25) , który potrafi jeździć na rowerze BMX. 🚲

📅 Terminy: 18.11 i 23.11

💰 Stawka: do ustalenia.

📩 ZGŁOSZENIA:

casting@constantin-entertainment.pl

W zgłoszeniu koniecznie podaj:
• wiek,  
• opis doświadczenia aktorskiego,  
• demo aktorskie lub wizytówkę.

W tytule wpisz: BMX 

🎥 Masz doświadczenie aktorskie i potrafisz jeździć na BMX? 
Czekamy na Twoje zgłoszenie!

Do zobaczenia na planie „Młodych glin”!
Osoby, które już wysłały swoje zgłoszenie nie muszą powtarzać

items.text:
WARSZAWA!! 🎬
Na plan serialu „Gliniarze” poszukuję statystów do następujących ról:

📅 09.11 – Mężczyzna (35–40 lat) – 200 zł

Ofiara. Mężczyzna niepozorny, chudy, drobny, o lekkiej budowie ciała.

📅 10.11 – Mundurowy – 150 zł

📅 11.11 – Mieszkaniec osiedla – 150 zł

📅 11.11 – Mundurowy – 150 zł

📅 12.11 – Sąsiad (65–75 lat) – 150 zł

Przygarbiony, pogodny emeryt.

📅 12.11 – Hazardzistka (60–65 lat) – 150 zł

Stała klientka salonu z maszynami do gry. Koniecznie kręcone włosy!

📅 13.11 – Mundurowy – 200 zł

💰 Wynagrodzenie płatne gotówką po planie.

📩 Zgłoszenia proszę przesyłać na adres:

casting@outsetfilms.pl

W tytule wiadomości proszę wpisać wybraną postać i datę.

W zgłoszeniu proszę podać:

* Imię i nazwisko

* Wiek

* Wzrost

* Numer telefonu

* Aktualne zdjęcie twarzy i sylwetki

🎬🎬🎬 MEGA ULTRA PILNE! CASTING! 🎬🎬🎬

AKTORKI, AKTORZY,  EPIZODYSTKI I EPIZODYŚCI 

– ROLKI / TIKTOK / IG

Szanowni Państwo!

Na czwartek, 12 listopada 

poszukujemy aktorek, aktorów,  epizodystek i epizodystów 

do krótkiej formy komercyjnej realizowanej 
na potrzeby kanałów TikTok i Instagram (IG).

🎥 KOGO SZUKAMY?

✅ Kobiet i mężczyzn w wieku 25–50 lat 

✅ Osób polskojęzycznych 

✅ Osób posiadających doświadczenie w pracy przed kamerą

Poszukujemy osób do wielu różnych ról, 
które wcielą się w postaci pracowników 
i klientów marketu.

💰 WYNAGRODZENIE: 500–1000 zł netto

Stawka uzależniona jest od przypisanej postaci i zakresu roli. 
Po zakwalifikowaniu zgłoszonych osób 
do konkretnych postaci skontaktujemy się 
z wybranymi osobami i poinformujemy je 
o proponowanej stawce.

📍 MIEJSCE REALIZACJI: Warszawa

📅 TERMIN: CZWARTEK,  12 listopada 

🕘 GODZINY: pierwsza połowa dnia

📩 JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ?

Osoby zainteresowane i dyspozycyjne prosimy 
o przesłanie zgłoszenia w wiadomości e-mail 

na adres:  📧 abcastingab@gmail.com

📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭

W zgłoszeniu prosimy wpisać:

• Temat: ROLKI  12. 11
• Imię i nazwisko
• Wiek
• Numer telefonu
• Zdjęcie twarzy oraz zdjęcie całej sylwetki
• Informację o doświadczeniu w pracy przed kamerą
• Linki do materiałów wideo, na których można Państwa zobaczyć i usłyszeć

🎬 Poszukujemy osób do wielu postaci — jeśli masz doświadczenie przed kamerą i jesteś dyspozycyjny/a w środę, serdecznie zapraszamy do zgłoszeń!

Do zobaczenia na planie! 🎥🤝

🎬 POSZUKUJEMY AKTORKI DO ETIUDY FILMOWEJ.
Hej! 

Do realizacji etiudy studenckiej poszukujemy aktorki do roli ANNY (34-38 lat).

O postaci:

Anna to atrakcyjna, pewna siebie kobieta o wyrazistej osobowości. Ma ciemno-brązowe i charakterystyczny styl inspirowany latami 80. 

Kogo szukamy?

- Aktorki o ciemno-brązowych włosach.

- Wiek około 30-40 (lub osoby wiarygodnie wyglądającej na ten wiek).

- Osoby swobodnie czującej się przed kamerą.

- Mile widziane doświadczenie aktorskie, ale nie jest ono warunkiem koniecznym.

📍 Miejsce realizacji: Warszawa

📅 Termin zdjęć: 20 listopada 

Jeśli jesteś zainteresowana lub znasz kogoś, kto pasowałby do tej roli, zapraszam do kontaktu w wiadomości prywatnej!

Będę wdzięczna za udostępnienia! ❤️

🎬 CURRENTLY CASTING & RECRUITING CREW

"9 HATS" is an independent urban crime drama/thriller about Malik, a talented young man with dreams of becoming an engineer who is forced to make difficult choices when financial pressure, family responsibilities, and the streets begin pulling him in opposite directions.

We are currently looking for actors and behind-the-scenes crew who are interested in being part of an independent feature film production.

Target Filming: December 2026 / January 2027
Location: New Jersey / surrounding area: Low-budget independent production

Just looking for a chance to make both of us BIG ✨‼️

Compensation: Unpaid/volunteer opportunity
What We Provide: Meals/refreshments during production, production experience, screen credit, footage/materials when applicable, and an opportunity to be part of a feature-length film. 

This is a passion project being built by an independent filmmaker looking to create a serious, gritty, cinematic urban film with a dedicated team.

If you're passionate about filmmaking, acting, cinematography, lighting, sound, directing, production, makeup, wardrobe, or other areas of film production, we would love to hear from you.

Contact: holduptvfilms@gmail.com

🎬 CASTING CALL — LITTLE-PERSON ACTOR WANTED
📍 San Antonio, Texas

I’m casting for an original independent comedy series blending chaotic humor, indie storytelling, and heartfelt moments.

ROLE: FEMALE GUEST CHARACTER — ONE EPISODE

Looking for a little-person actress who can fully embody a character, has strong comedic timing, and can bring a unique personality to the screen.

The character is an ex-girlfriend who brings unexpected energy, tension, and comedy into the story. We’re looking for someone who can make the audience laugh while still making the character feel real.

🎭 One-episode guest appearance

💰 Compensation: Up to $100

📍 San Antonio, TX

📅 Filming date to be determined

Acting experience is a plus. Please Email me a headshot, a short introduction, and any acting clips or reels you have @ jeunevela@gmail.com

Independent production. More details about the character and script will be shared with interested performers.

Please share with anyone who might be a fit! 🎥

**CASTING CALL | SINGERS & DANCERS | LOS ANGELES**

Bethesda Repertory Theatre is seeking singers and/or dancers of all backgrounds, styles, and genres for our upcoming holiday production of *An Evening With Company*.

Now in its third consecutive year, this groundbreaking, devised musical celebration brings together a diverse ensemble of artists for an unforgettable evening of music, storytelling, and holiday spirit at Stomping Ground LA. We're looking for passionate and collaborative performers who bring their own unique stories to the stage. Whether your background is musical theatre, jazz, pop, classical, contemporary, or something entirely different, we want to see what you do.

SUBMISSIONS

Please email the following to our Resident Casting Director, Shelby Mumford, at [shelby@bethesdarep.com](mailto:shelby@bethesdarep.com):
* A recent 1–2 minute self-tape or video showcasing your singing and/or dancing.
* Headshot and Résumé
* Your availability for in-person callbacks on **[Monday evening](x-apple-data-detectors://embedded-result/947)****, October 26**, in Glendale.

SUBMISSION DEADLINE: End of Day **Friday, October 23**

PRODUCTION SCHEDULE

Rehearsals | Glendale

Monday, Tuesday, & Thursday Evenings beginning in November

Tech & Performances | Stomping Ground LA
* [Tuesday, Dec 15](x-apple-data-detectors://embedded-result/1186): Tech & Dress | [9:30 AM–6 PM](x-apple-data-detectors://embedded-result/1218)
* [Wednesday, Dec 16](x-apple-data-detectors://embedded-result/1231): Dress & Preview Performance | [4–11 PM](x-apple-data-detectors://embedded-result/1280)
* [Thursday, Dec 17](x-apple-data-detectors://embedded-result/1288): Gala Performance | [4–11 PM](x-apple-data-detectors://embedded-result/1325)

VOLUNTEER PARTICIPATION

As a growing nonprofit, we unfortunately cannot offer monetary compensation to our Performers for this production. We deeply value the time, talent, and commitment of every artist who contributes to our work, and providing meaningful compensation remains an important goal as Bethesda continues to grow. We understand that an unpaid opportunity may not be feasible for everyone and sincerely appreciate your consideration.

Join us as we continue building a joyful holiday tradition that celebrates the extraordinary talent and creativity of our Los Angeles artistic community.

SUBMIT BY OCTOBER 23: [shelby@bethesdarep.com](mailto:shelby@bethesdarep.com)

Learn more about Bethesda at BethesdaRep.com.

Please share with your fellow singers, dancers, and performers!

items.text:
Ever notice how often Shakespeare brings up snakes and serpents?
Which one hits hardest for you: the fairy lullaby, Lady Macbeth’s advice, or Cleopatra’s final companion? 🧵👇
#Shakespeare #SnakesInShakespeare

🐍 The Fairy Lullaby
A Midsummer Night’s Dream (2.2)
“You spotted snakes with double tongue,
Thorny hedgehogs, be not seen;
Newts and blind-worms, do no wrong,
Come not near our fairy queen.”
Pure protection magic.

🐍 The Snake’s Skin
A Midsummer Night’s Dream (2.1)
Oberon describes Titania’s bower:
“And there the snake throws her enamelled skin,
Weed wide enough to wrap a fairy in.”
One of the most beautiful images of a snake in the entire canon.

🐍 Lady Macbeth’s Masterclass in Deception
Macbeth (1.5)
“Look like the innocent flower,
But be the serpent under’t.”
Still one of the sharpest lines about hiding true intent.

🐍 The Unfinished Job
Macbeth (3.2)
“We have scotch’d the snake, not kill’d it:
She’ll close and be herself…”
Macbeth realizes half-measures with danger only make things worse.

🐍 The Ghost’s Revelation
Hamlet (1.5)
“’Tis given out that, sleeping in my orchard,
A serpent stung me…
The serpent that did sting thy father’s life
Now wears his crown.”
The ultimate political snake.

🐍 The Sharpest Pain
King Lear (1.4)
“How sharper than a serpent’s tooth it is
To have a thankless child!”
Still the definitive line on parental betrayal.

🐍 Juliet’s Heartbreak
Romeo and Juliet (3.2)
“O serpent heart, hid with a flowering face!”
Beauty as camouflage for something deadly.

🐍 Cleopatra’s Serpent of Old Nile
Antony and Cleopatra
Antony calls her “my serpent of old Nile.”
Later she chooses the aspic as her final companion:
“Have I the aspic in my lips?”
Death by serpent becomes royal.

🐍 Other notable appearances
• “It is the bright day that brings forth the adder” – Julius Caesar
• “A green and gilded snake” coiled around Oliver – As You Like It
• “I fear me you but warm the starved snake” – Henry VI, Part 2
• “Fillet of a fenny snake” in the witches’ cauldron – Macbeth
• “Could not a worm, an adder, do so much?” – A Midsummer Night’s Dream
• Vipers as insults in Richard II, Coriolanus, Henry V, and more

Shakespeare’s snakes are rarely just animals.
They’re metaphors for treachery, hidden danger, temptation, and sometimes even seductive power.
Which of these serpent lines is your favorite? Drop it below.
#ShakespeareQuotes #LiterarySnakes #Bard #snakes #WilliamShakespeare #theater #theatre

🐍 The Unfinished Job
Macbeth (3.2)
“We have scotch’d the snake, not kill’d it:
She’ll close and be herself…”
Macbeth realizes half-measures with danger only make things worse.

🐍 The Ghost’s Revelation
Hamlet (1.5)
“’Tis given out that, sleeping in my orchard,
A serpent stung me…
The serpent that did sting thy father’s life
Now wears his crown.”
The ultimate political snake.

🐍 The Sharpest Pain
King Lear (1.4)
“How sharper than a serpent’s tooth it is
To have a thankless child!”
Still the definitive line on parental betrayal.

🐍 Juliet’s Heartbreak
Romeo and Juliet (3.2)
“O serpent heart, hid with a flowering face!”
Beauty as camouflage for something deadly.

🐍 Cleopatra’s Serpent of Old Nile
Antony and Cleopatra
Antony calls her “my serpent of old Nile.”
Later she chooses the aspic as her final companion:
“Have I the aspic in my lips?”
Death by serpent becomes royal.

🐍 Other notable appearances
• “It is the bright day that brings forth the adder” – Julius Caesar
• “A green and gilded snake” coiled around Oliver – As You Like It
• “I fear me you but warm the starved snake” – Henry VI, Part 2
• “Fillet of a fenny snake” in the witches’ cauldron – Macbeth
• “Could not a worm, an adder, do so much?” – A Midsummer Night’s Dream
• Vipers as insults in Richard II, Coriolanus, Henry V, and more

Shakespeare’s snakes are rarely just animals.
They’re metaphors for treachery, hidden danger, temptation, and sometimes even seductive power.
Which of these serpent lines is your favorite? Drop it below.
#ShakespeareQuotes #LiterarySnakes #Bard #snakes #WilliamShakespeare #theater #theatre

CASTING CALL — THE BROS SHOW
**SIX ROLES AVAILABLE | SOUTH OR WEST LONDON**

**Unpaid acting opportunities | Independent South London sitcom**

We're expanding the cast of *The Bros Show* and looking for new actors to join our independent comedy series!

*The Bros Show* is a South London teen sitcom combining chaotic comedy, friendship, rivalry, everyday life and mockumentary-style filming. We're looking for people who can bring characters to life through natural acting, personality, banter and strong reactions.

**ROLES AVAILABLE**
1. Lainey — Christmas Special

Guest / Special appearance

Playing age: 17

Description: A confident, blunt and mysterious girl with a long history with Aweys, Abdi and Aiden. She has a habit of appearing unexpectedly, making sarcastic remarks and acting like nothing bothers her.

Character base:
* Childhood friend of the original Bros.
* Childhood partners in crime with Aweys.
* Shares a secret handshake with Aweys.
* Protective of Abdi.
* Enjoys teasing Aiden.
* Has unresolved feelings for Aweys.
* Independent, stubborn and fiercely loyal.

Christmas Special purpose: Her return introduces an unexpected reunion, old memories and a little romantic tension.

**2. POSH BIRD 2**

Playful, mischievous and outspoken. She's always ready to join the group's banter, stir things up and bring chaotic energy to a scene.

**3. POSH BIRD 4**

The wildcard of the group. Flirty, cocky, forceful and unpredictable, she brings tension to the story, particularly through her rivalry with Lainey. This role needs someone who can balance confidence, humour and dramatic presence.

**4. AUNTIE 2**

One half of the auntie duo. We're looking for an actress with expressive reactions, natural delivery, personality and good comedic timing who can bounce off another performer.

**5.** MA-JAX

A cheeky, street-smart teenager from New Harbour who is secretly sort of a prince. Despite his royal connections, he spends most of his time chilling and hanging out with the Bros. His ridiculously grand full name is James Penthony Alexander Jones Max the 8th, but everyone calls him Ma-Jax. He and Aweys operate like partners, often teaming up and coming up with ideas together, while he gets along well with Abdi. However, he has constant beef with Aiden, who regularly throws him out of the house in a running gag reminiscent of Jazz from The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air. He also has an ongoing rivalry with Callum. Most of the others aren't particularly fond of him, although Diva Girl has a soft spot for him. We're looking for an actor with confidence, cheeky personality, natural British delivery, expressive reactions and excellent comedic timing who can bring his chaotic relationships and royal background to life.

**6. PC THOMPSON**

A police constable with a grounded, believable presence. We're looking for clear dialogue, natural acting and strong reactions, with the ability to work well alongside another performer.

1. Posh Bird 3 

 basically herself, playful the quietest most chirpful in the group and doesn't give a damn about the rivaliry simiar to baby spice from the spice girls 

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**
* Natural acting and believable dialogue.
* Good comedic timing and expressive reactions.
* Confidence performing from a short script.
* Reliability and willingness to take direction.
* Availability for agreed rehearsals and filming.

Professional acting experience is welcome but not essential. Applicants should be willing to learn lines and take part in a self-tape audition.

**LOCATION REQUIREMENT**

Applicants must be based in **South or West London** and able to travel to agreed filming and rehearsal locations.

**SELF-TAPE DEADLINES**

Shortlisted applicants will normally have **3 days to submit their self-tape**, with a maximum of **5 days** where that is the agreed deadline.

If you need additional time, contact the casting team before your deadline. Reasonable extensions may be agreed.

Please take deadlines seriously. If an applicant repeatedly misses an agreed deadline without communicating, their audition may be withdrawn and another candidate considered.

**PRODUCTION TERMS**
* This is an unpaid independent production.
* Travel, food and other expenses are not guaranteed.
* Filming dates, rehearsal arrangements and locations will be discussed with shortlisted applicants before any commitment.
* Applicants under 18 must involve a parent or guardian in the casting and production arrangements.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Please send:
1. Your preferred name.
2. Your age.
3. Your general location (South or West London).
4. Recent photos.
5. Acting experience or a showreel, if available.
6. Your availability for rehearsals and filming.
7. Which role or roles you would like to audition for.

Please don't send your full home address or other sensitive personal information.

Shortlisted applicants will receive further audition instructions and their self-tape scene.

**ABOUT THE PROJECT**

We're building a cast for an original independent series, and this is an opportunity to be part of a developing creative project. Please apply only if you're comfortable with the unpaid terms and can communicate reliably with the production team.

**THE BROS SHOW — Seven ROLES. ONE CHAOTIC UNIVERSE.**

If you're interested, get in touch and tell us which character you'd like to play!

Television Comedy Writer Seeking Representation by Agent or Manager
TLTR: Looking for agent/manager in television comedy for original pilots and a reboot project

Hello everyone (bots included)! My name is Cheyenne L. Harlow, an LA transplant from Georgia, pursuing representation by an agent or manager specialized in television comedy. I am both an actress, sitcom writer, and standup comedian with a lengthy educational background in Theatre and Improv.  

I’ve lived in the nitty gritty of LA for the past four years, working two, sometimes three jobs at a time, on a daily bus commute filled to the brim with characters. With those experiences, one can safely assume I primarily write about working class people who are simply trying to survive in a society set out against them, and they’d be correct. Add a few oddball misfits and you have a comedy. One of my pilots encapsulates that idea perfectly in an oddly comforting love letter to LA. 

I’m also fondly inspired by nostalgic sitcoms that I grew up with as a millennial raised by their grandmother, following into shows beyond my age, such as, Golden Girls, Threes Company, The Brady Bunch, Gilligans Island, I Dream of Jeannie, I Love Lucy, and so many other classics. 

That’s why it only made sense when one of my comforting escapes from reality became my fuel to write comedy. 

At the age of 10, I had fallen in love with the idea of bringing this universe back to life with a new set of circumstances. In 2017, while studying theatre in college, I voiced this aloud to one of my classmates that sparked that thought into a full-fledged concept. 

Between then and now, I was reaching out to the show-runner of The Nanny on social media. He responded with appreciation, but also the urge to find representation prior to pitch. Something tells me that he greatly underestimated how dedicated I was to bringing this project to life. I packed my life up in Georgia in 2022, moved to Los Angeles in 2023 and I’ve been here ever since. 

Upon a kismet happenstance, I met the showrunner of The Nanny in pure coincidence within my first few months in Los Angeles, back in 2023, on Mother’s Day.

By 2026, my concept had aged itself out and I had to adapt, using a new concept with the same bones to it. Stronger than ever. I was recovering from gastric sleeve surgery, out of a 9-5 job, and it seemed like a better time than ever to do what I set out to do. I wrote six episodes, revised, all in three months. I had colleagues and fellow writers read it over and over for feedback. Now, it only needs to land in front of the right eyes to represent it for pitching. 

I have multiple original pilots accompanied by their visual pitch decks and series bibles. The reboot itself supported by even more, granted it’s been in the making for several years.

If you’ve read to the end of this long spiel, I truly appreciate it. For those who have issue with the length, I can only assume aren’t who it’s for. I’m hoping that anyone networking in LA has the right connections to make this pitch a reality for me and I’d be forever indebted to anyone who can push me in the right direction. 

Love, Cheyenne ✨💖

items.text:
My name is Tamer a photographer based in Berlin and I’m currently looking to connect with other photographers, model agencies and creative art teams here in Berlin 

My work focuses in street photography, still photography, urban environment, landscape photography and street portraits with a strong focus on catching emotions and show them in an organic artistic way which define my photography style. 
I shoot with both analog and digital cameras
I’m especially interested in joining a team where I can shoot regularly and work with models or artists
I am also interested in doing photo walks here in Berlin with other photographers
I would love to help other people who would like to start learning more about photography in general and encourage them to go slowly into the world of photography
If you know any studio or agency or photographer or production company looking for a photographer, I’d love to hear from you guys
Here is my instagram if you would like to check my work 
Tamer_prime_84

AUDITIONS FOR DE KOVEN'S LIGHT OPERA: ROBIN HOOD

Music by Reginald De Koven - Libretto by Harry B. Smith

Auditions are held at Avon Free Public Library - Board Room on 2nd Floor at 281 Country Club Road, Avon, Connecticut 06001. Audition: Nov 21st [3:00 pm - 5:00 pm] & Nov 24th [6:00 PM - 8:00 PM] Please prepare 32 measures, please provide your own backing 

Rehearsals: 

Rehearsals: Mondays and Wednesdays nights starting Jan 18th [5pm to 8pm]

Tech: March 15-17. [5pm - 8pm]

Performances: March 19 (7pm) & 20 (7pm) at The Canton Community Baptist Church - 125 Dowd Ave, Canton, CT 06019

Volunteer, Non Union, No Travel or Board Provided

[https://forms.gle/fCEtvFAtrtTHAyAc6](https://forms.gle/fCEtvFAtrtTHAyAc6?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAcGRvZgVicmlkETFoNHgwMEQ4eTExRkNscVRSc3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABH-MGU0DmGHeFQ3Ub7LG9Vamy1555kYKnDrGCPYPpz6c62emI0nTESNxp8WH4_aem_6BOG4zlGkhqVz97drZ2w4A)

Robert, Earl of Huntington, wins the admiration of the outlaws by his marksmanship, whilst the Sheriff of Nottingham repudiates his claims to the Earldom and declares Guy of Gisborne the real heir. Robert joins the outlaws and becomes the celebrated Robin Hood. Lady Marian has been commanded by the King to wed the Earl of Huntington and comes in disguise to see what sort of man he may be. With Robert she is well pleased, and they plight their troth, but when the wily Sheriff substitutes Guy as the Earl, Lady Marian conceals the King’s decrees, commanding her to marry him.

FLIGHTTIME PRODUCTIONS

FINAL OPEN CASTING CALL

DIVA AIRWAYS: THE RISE & FALL

A Three-Act Comedy-Drama | World Premiere — Chicago, 2027

NON-UNION ACTORS ONLY | PAID ROLES

FlightTime Productions is seeking talented and dedicated performers for its upcoming world-premiere production of Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall, written and directed by Matthew Stevens.

Join us for this exciting original comedy-drama filled with laughter, friendship, family, workplace rivalries, and unexpected turbulence!

OPEN AUDITION INFORMATION

Monday, November 9, 2026

11:00 AM – 4:00 PM

West Loop Branch Library — Meeting Room

122 N. Aberdeen Street

Chicago, IL 60607

NO APPOINTMENT NECESSARY!

Audition check-in closes promptly at 4:00 PM.

AVAILABLE ROLES

All roles offer an $800 performance stipend.

* COLIN (16+) — Alexa’s caring younger brother, struggling with complicated family relationships.

* TIFFANY BELMONT (16+) — Miss Brooks’ stylish, ambitious, outspoken, and hilariously unpredictable assistant.

* BROOKLYN (16+) — The rival airline CEO’s daughter, whose loyalty begins to shift toward Diva Airways.

* SABRINA (25+) — A hardworking, loyal airline lounge manager confronting the company’s financial challenges.

AUDITION REQUIREMENTS

Please prepare a 1–2 minute comedic or dramatic monologue and bring a current headshot and acting résumé. Performers will also participate in group improvisation activities.

CALLBACKS — BY INVITATION ONLY

Friday, November 13, 2026 | 10:00 AM

Pullman Branch Library

11001 S. Indiana Avenue

Chicago, IL 60628

REHEARSALS & PERFORMANCES

Rehearsals Begin: January 10, 2027

Technical Rehearsals: April 4–7, 2027

Performance Engagement: April 8 – May 30, 2027

QUESTIONS & CASTING INQUIRIES

divaairwaysstage@gmail.com

Please note: West Loop Branch Library is not affiliated with or a sponsor of this production.

FLIGHTTIME PRODUCTIONS

Where the drama is first class, the comedy is nonstop, and the turbulence is guaranteed!

Wir suchen Darstellerinnen und Darsteller für unsere Tatort-Dinner-Produktionen! Du hast Freude an Schauspiel, Improvisation und dem direkten Kontakt zum Publikum? Bei uns warten unterschiedliche Rollenprofile und abwechslungsreiche Krimi-Abende auf dich.

Unser Produktionsstandort ist Bochum. Die Auftritte finden fast ausschließlich im Umkreis von bis zu 130 Kilometern rund um Bochum statt. Dein Wohnort sollte daher im Ruhrgebiet oder maximal etwa 100 Kilometer von Bochum entfernt liegen.

Voraussetzung ist eine schauspielerische Ausbildung oder langjährige Theatererfahrung.

Interesse? Dann schick uns deine Bewerbung mit Foto und Vita an:

uwe@seinepost.de

#TatortDinner #DarstellerGesucht #Schauspiel #Theater #Krimidinner #Ruhrgebiet #NRW

items.text:
🚨 INTERNATIONAL CASTING CALL! 🇵🇱🌍

🎭 DANCERS • ACTORS • SINGERS • MUSICAL THEATRE PERFORMERS – WE’RE CALLING YOU!

🔥 FOR THE FIRST TIME EVER – A LONDON-BASED TALENT AGENCY IS HOLDING AN OFFICIAL INTERNATIONAL CASTING IN POLAND, OPEN TO PERFORMERS FROM AROUND THE WORLD!

On 29 November, Warsaw will host an exclusive casting for international talent agency ROBERTS & DAY MANAGEMENT (LONDON)!

🎬 NETFLIX • DISNEY • WARNER BROS. • APPLE

These are some of the biggest names in film and television, whose production and casting teams the agency’s director works with, connecting represented talent with international auditions and opportunities!

🌎 AND IT’S DEFINITELY NOT JUST ABOUT THE WEST END!

Artists represented by Roberts & Day work across a wide range of international entertainment industries:

🎥 Film, television, series and streaming productions

📺 Commercial campaigns and branded projects – including M&S, Spotify and Currys

🎭 Musicals, theatre productions and international tours – BACK TO THE FUTURE, SIX, JESUS CHRIST SUPERSTAR

🚢 Luxury cruise ship contracts – including ROYAL CARIBBEAN, VIKING CRUISES and CELEBRITY CRUISES

🌴 International entertainment productions, including resort-based shows and projects

🔥 MATTHEW ROBERTS, founder and director of the agency, will personally travel to Warsaw to hold an OFFICIAL CASTING FOR INTERNATIONAL PRODUCTION – THE AGENCY’S DEDICATED INTERNATIONAL DIVISION!

This is a unique opportunity for performers from around the world to be considered for international representation and open doors to productions worldwide – not just in the UK!

No need to travel to London. No UK visa required at the audition stage.

✨ AND THE DAY BEFORE? ANOTHER INTERNATIONAL OPPORTUNITY!

📅 28 NOV | LISA STEVENS – AUDITION WORKSHOP & MOCK AUDITION

An International Emmy Award-nominated director and choreographer whose credits include major Broadway, West End, Disney and Netflix productions!

⭐ HIGH SCHOOL MUSICAL • 9 TO 5 • BOMBAY DREAMS • SPAMALOT • FEAR STREET: PROM QUEEN (NETFLIX)

During this workshop, you’ll learn the professional standards of international auditions, experience a realistic mock audition and receive individual feedback!

🎯 AND THERE’S MORE! Lisa Stevens will also be scouting talent for her own international productions taking place across Europe!

The Saturday workshop offers an additional opportunity to develop your skills and showcase your talent – attendance is not mandatory.

📍 WARSAW | 28–29 NOVEMBER 2026

🎭 Casting: Ages 16+ | Dancers, Actors, Singers & Musical Theatre Performers

📩 APPLICATION DEADLINE: 25 NOVEMBER!

🌍 THE INTERNATIONAL ENTERTAINMENT INDUSTRY IS COMING TO POLAND. ARE YOU READY?

👇 Full details, audition requirements and application forms are available in the event!

SPOTLIGHTCOMPANY.PL

sharedPost.text:
🚨 INTERNATIONAL CASTING CALL! 🇵🇱🌍

🎭 TANCERZE • AKTORZY • WOKALIŚCI • MUSICAL PERFORMERS – WE’RE CALLING YOU!

🔥 PO RAZ PIERWSZY W POLSCE – LONDYŃSKA AGENCJA ARTYSTYCZNA OTWIERA SPECJALNY NABÓR DLA POLSKICH ARTYSTÓW!

Już 29 listopada w Warszawie odbędzie się wyjątkowy casting do międzynarodowej agencji ROBERTS & DAY MANAGEMENT (LONDON)!

🎬 NETFLIX • DISNEY • WARNER BROS. • APPLE

To giganci branży filmowej i telewizyjnej, z których zespołami produkcyjnymi i castingowymi współpracuje dyrektor agencji, otwierając swoim artystom dostęp do międzynarodowych przesłuchań i projektów!

🌎 A TO ZDECYDOWANIE NIE TYLKO WEST END!

Artyści reprezentowani przez Roberts & Day pracują w szerokim spektrum międzynarodowej branży rozrywkowej:

🎥 Film, telewizja, seriale i produkcje streamingowe

📺 Kampanie reklamowe i projekty komercyjne – m.in. M&S, Spotify, Currys

🎭 Musicale, spektakle teatralne i międzynarodowe trasy – BACK TO THE FUTURE, SIX, JESUS CHRIST SUPERSTAR

🚢 Kontrakty na luksusowych statkach wycieczkowych – m.in. ROYAL CARIBBEAN, VIKING CRUISES, CELEBRITY CRUISES

🌴 Międzynarodowe produkcje rozrywkowe, w tym formaty realizowane w resortach

🔥 MATTHEW ROBERTS, założyciel i dyrektor agencji, przyjedzie osobiście do Warszawy, aby przeprowadzić OFICJALNY CASTING DO INTERNATIONAL PRODUCTION – WYODRĘBNIONEGO MIĘDZYNARODOWEGO DZIAŁU AGENCJI!

To specjalna okazja dla polskich artystów, aby ubiegać się o międzynarodową reprezentację i otworzyć sobie drogę do zagranicznych produkcji – również poza Wielką Brytanią!

FINAL OPEN CASTING CALL

DIVA AIRWAYS: THE RISE & FALL

A Three-Act Comedy-Drama | World Premiere — Chicago, 2027

NON-UNION ACTORS ONLY | PAID ROLES

FlightTime Productions is seeking talented and dedicated performers for its upcoming world-premiere production of Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall, written and directed by Matthew Stevens.

Join us for this exciting original comedy-drama filled with laughter, friendship, family, workplace rivalries, and unexpected turbulence!

OPEN AUDITION INFORMATION

Monday, November 9, 2026

11:00 AM – 4:00 PM

West Loop Branch Library — Meeting Room

122 N. Aberdeen Street

Chicago, IL 60607

NO APPOINTMENT NECESSARY!

Audition check-in closes promptly at 4:00 PM.

AVAILABLE ROLES

All roles offer an $800 performance stipend.

* COLIN (16+) — Alexa’s caring younger brother, struggling with complicated family relationships.

* TIFFANY BELMONT (16+) — Miss Brooks’ stylish, ambitious, outspoken, and hilariously unpredictable assistant.

* BROOKLYN (16+) — The rival airline CEO’s daughter, whose loyalty begins to shift toward Diva Airways.

* SABRINA (25+) — A hardworking, loyal airline lounge manager confronting the company’s financial challenges.

AUDITION REQUIREMENTS

Please prepare a 1–2 minute comedic or dramatic monologue and bring a current headshot and acting résumé. Performers will also participate in group improvisation activities.

items.text:
Question for parents of child models!/ performers❤️
I’ve been researching how to get a trust account set up for my daughter as she begins her modeling journey, along with obtaining a work permit for her to work in New York.

I’m seeing different options for setting up a trust account, some through paid services and others that you can establish yourself for little to no cost.

For parents who have been through this process:

* How did you go about setting up your child’s trust account?

* Is it better to do it yourself or use a service?

* What is the process for obtaining a New York child performer work permit?

Any advice, recommendations, or resources would be greatly appreciated! I’m just trying to make sure I have everything in place and do things the right way for her. 💕

topComments.text: Go to Chase and do it yourself. It’s quick and easy.

Trust info depends on where you are located and where you will primarily be working 

In NYC a UTMA is sufficient.   You do not have to have a Coogan.  
UTMA we obtained through our credit union.  Some large banks also have them (Wells Fargo, PNC, Chase, etc).  Go to your bank or Credit Union and see if a UTMA is available.   
The biggest benefit of UTMA is you can access those funds and move them to high yield CDs or Roth Accts.  

If working in Chicago or LA a Coogan is required.  Coogans just kinda sit.  Most banks that offer Coogans you can't put into CDs or high yeild savings. So they earn little to nothing and can't be accessed until child is an adult.  
Coogans you can get through Actors Federal Credit ( online) or Wells Fargo.  But Wells Fargo you have to currently have a worked job, not just an agent.  

So my suggestion.   
Open a UTMA.  That is sufficient most states.  If you plan on spreading to markets where Coogan is required, then open Coogan only for the earning from those states that require. 

My kids will have more "income" from the high yeild CD interest and Roth, then they will have actually earned working.  So for us everything that can go into UTMA does.

Question for parents of child models!/ performers❤️
I’ve been researching how to get a trust account set up for my daughter as she begins her modeling journey, along with obtaining a work permit for her to work in New York.

I’m seeing different options for setting up a trust account, some through paid services and others that you can establish yourself for little to no cost.

For parents who have been through this process:

* How did you go about setting up your child’s trust account?

* Is it better to do it yourself or use a service?

* What is the process for obtaining a New York child performer work permit?

Any advice, recommendations, or resources would be greatly appreciated! I’m just trying to make sure I have everything in place and do things the right way for her. 💕

🩰✨ LITTLE FEET, BIG DREAMS! ✨🩰

Our Saturday morning Tap & Ballet classes at All the Arts are the perfect introduction to the wonderful world of dance! 🌟

Designed for children aged 3–6 years, our fun and engaging classes help little dancers develop confidence, coordination, musicality and rhythm, all whilst making new friends and having lots of fun!

With 30 minutes of Tap and 30 minutes of Ballet, our young performers enjoy the best of both worlds, learning essential dance techniques in a nurturing and encouraging environment.

Our classes also follow the IDTA dance syllabus, giving children the opportunity to work towards recognised dance examinations as they progress.

🩰 Saturdays | 8.45–9.45am
📍 New Eltham
🌟 Ages 3–6 years

Whether your little one dreams of dancing on stage or simply loves moving to music, we’d love to welcome them to All the Arts!
